title: Identification of Potential Predictive Biomarkers during JAK-inhibitor Therapies in Rheumatoid Arthritis
description: Targeted synthetic therapeutics, such as Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitors, have opened up a new platform for the treatment of various diseases, including rheumatoid arthritis (RA). As with all drugs, the efficacy of different medicine may vary from patient to patient, and there may be different side effects if the expected effect is not achieved. Our research aims to fill this scientific gap in the knowledge of the use JAK inhibitors in RA based on changes of gene expression patterns of peripheral blood mononuclear cells and to determine a set of genes that would allow to distinguish between responder and non-responder patients.
